footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income: includes a $1.0M income tax benefit.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 69.4% to $2.2B in 2025. Gross margin was 91.2%, versus 90.5% a year earlier, and operating income was $442M, up from a $561M loss.
Net income was $530M, or $2.62 per share, after a $484M loss a year earlier. Operating cash flow was $691M and free cash flow $684M, versus $216M.
watch: Net income includes a $1.0M tax benefit.
sources: Reddit, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
